additional_sample_weight: None; retain LogisticRegression balanced class weights within each fitted training cohort; booster unweighted
baseline_comparison: Reuse hash-pinned validation counts for public candidate and old/alternative rules; effective deployed synthetic DGA path equals the mandatory conservative guard on valid DNS names, independent of synthetic posterior; not standalone raw synthetic-model accuracy
fold_isolation: Each fold vocabulary, IDF, numeric mean/scale and logistic encoder fit only other training folds. Score held training fold once. Fit boosted stack on OOF logits and raw exact numeric training features. Refit final encoder on full training for export.
limitations: Family prefix grouping does not prove alias independence
Validation is previously inspected development data
Production generalization and separate benign-DNS FPR remain unmeasured
oof_assignment: SHA256(namespace + family: + prefix before first underscore) modulo 3 for positive rows; SHA256(namespace + benign: + canonical_label) modulo 3 for benign rows; family only partitions rows, never predictor
predictive_features: ml.dga.tokens first-label character 2/3-grams; ml.dga.lexical_features exact ten numeric fields; no new features

promotion_gates.metric_denominator: domain recall=TP/(TP+FN), precision=TP/(TP+FP), domain FPR=FP/(FP+TN) on the frozen balanced 3000-positive/3000-negative domain set; separate DNS FPR=FP/(FP+TN) on its distinct benign labels
promotion_gates.rule: all four gates must pass on the single frozen reserved evaluation; no threshold search, feature tuning, sample replacement, or gate adjustment after seeing it

reserved_evaluation: Unavailable. Final recall/precision/domain FPR/separate benign-DNS FPR unmeasured. Do not substitute inspected comparison or second DNS. Stop disabled; do not acquire new data or lower gates in this experiment.
scope: One disabled DGA candidate; one training-only OOF intervention; frozen validation threshold 0.9; no reserved scoring until eligible materialization exists
single_hypothesis: Replace the boosted stack training input in-sample base logit with training-only out-of-fold logits
stop_rule: If validation fails, failure analysis only and recommend one experiment without implementing it. If validation passes but reserved data is unavailable, promotion blocked. No runtime integration.
threshold_selection: One preregistered value 0.9; no grid search, threshold rescue or second candidate
